source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 18 (PDF 118-136), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Quantum Physics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 State Planck's quantum theory of radiation. What is a photon? Derive expressions for the energy and momentum of a photon, and explain why quantum effects are noticed only for atom sized objects. (5 marks)
(Planck ki quantum theory of radiation bayan karein. Photon kya hai? Photon ki energy aur momentum ke formulas nikalein, aur batayein ke quantum asraat sirf atom jitne ajsaam mein kyun nazar aate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Quantum theory (Planck, 1901): Energy musalsal wave ki bajaye alag alag packets (quanta) mein kharij ya jazb hoti hai. Har quantum aik hi frequency f ki radiation se wabasta hai aur us ki energy f ke mutanasib hai:
E = hf ... (18.1)
jahan h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s Planck's constant hai.

Photon: Planck ne maana ke garam ajsaam ki radiation ki zarrati fitrat atoms ki kisi khaasiyat ki wajah se hai. Einstein ne kaha ke energy ke chhote bundles har electromagnetic radiation ka hissa hain aur taqseem nahi ho sakte. Inhi na-taqseem bundles ko photons kehte hain. λ wavelength ki roshni c raftaar se chalte photons ki dhaar hai, har aik ki energy E = hf = hc/λ.

Photon ka momentum: Relativity se E = mc² aur photon ka momentum p = mc. Is liye
E = pc ... (18.2)
Yani pc = hf, ya p = hf/c. c = fλ se
p = h/λ ... (18.3)

Quantum asraat sirf atom jitne ajsaam mein kyun: Spring par jhoolte mass jaise nizam ke energy steps itne chhote hain ke maloom nahi hote, is liye zarrati fitrat chhupi rehti hai. Sirf atom jitne ajsaam mein h kisi qabil-e-pemaish energy tabdeeli mein ahem hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Einstein extended his idea and postulated that packets or tiny bundles of energy are integral part of all electromagnetic radiations

blocks.prompt:
2 Orange light has wavelength 600 nm. Find (i) the energy of one photon in joule and in eV (ii) the momentum of the photon. (3 marks)
(Narangi roshni ki wavelength 600 nm hai. (i) Aik photon ki energy joule aur eV mein (ii) photon ka momentum nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Energy ke liye E = hc/λ, eV ke liye 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ se taqseem, aur momentum ke liye p = h/λ.

book_ref.quote: The energy E of each quantum is proportional to its frequency f related as

steps: p = h/λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/(600 × 10⁻⁹) = 1.11 × 10⁻²⁷ kg m s⁻¹ (p = E/c se bhi yahi)

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the apparatus used to study the photoelectric effect. Explain how the stopping potential gives the maximum kinetic energy of photoelectrons, how the photocurrent depends on intensity and frequency, and why these results cannot be explained by the wave theory of light. (5 marks)
(Photoelectric effect study karne ka apparatus bayan karein. Wazahat karein ke stopping potential se photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy kaise milti hai, photocurrent intensity aur frequency par kaise munhasir hai, aur yeh nataij wave theory se wazeh kyun nahi hote.)
blocks.explanation:
Photoelectric effect: Munasib frequency ki roshni parne par dhaat ki satah se electrons ka nikalna. Nikalne wale electrons photoelectrons hain.

Apparatus (Fig. 18.1): Khaali sheeshe ki tube mein do electrodes hain. Anode A battery ke positive aur dhaat ka cathode C negative terminal se juda hai. C par munasib frequency ki monochromatic roshni parne se electrons nikalte hain jo positive anode ki taraf khinchte hain; current micro-ammeter se napi jati hai. Roshni band karne par current ruk jati hai, yani yeh roshni ki wajah se hai: photoelectric current.

Stopping potential: Battery ulat dein taake A negative aur C positive ho. Photoelectrons dhakelay jate hain aur current kam hoti hai. Anode ko mazeed negative karne par aik qeemat V₀ (stopping potential) par current zero ho jati hai: sab se zyada energy wale electrons bhi nahi pahunchte. Is liye
½mv²max = V₀e ... (18.4)

Intensity ka asar (Fig. 18.2): Zyada intensity (I₂ > I₁) se current barhti hai magar usi V₀ par rukti hai.
Frequency ka asar (Fig. 18.3): Qaim intensity par current wahi magar har frequency ka V₀ alag; yani (K.E.)max frequency ke saath barhti hai.

Nataij:
(i) Electrons mukhtalif energies ke saath nikalte hain; zyada se zyada energy dhaat aur frequency par munhasir hai.
(ii) Threshold frequency f₀ se kam par koi electron nahi nikalta, roshni kitni hi tez ho (neeli roshni sodium se electrons nikalti hai, surkh nahi). f₀ har dhaat ki alag hai; is ki mutabiq wavelength threshold wavelength hai.
(iii) Electrons foran nikalte hain; intensity sirf un ki tadad tay karti hai.

Wave theory ki nakami: Wave theory ke mutabiq zyada intensity se K.E. barhni chahiye, jo tajurbe ke khilaf hai. Yeh threshold frequency bhi wazeh nahi karti: kam energy wali roshni ko bhi aakhir kaar electrons azad kar dene chahiye, magar aisa nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: The photoelectric effect is demonstrated by the apparatus shown in Fig. 18.1.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein anode ko aik jagah 'electrode B' likha hai; Fig. 18.1 aur agle paragraph mein yeh anode A hai (book correction). Yaad rakhein: intensity se tadad (current), frequency se energy (V₀) badalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 In a photoelectric experiment the stopping potential is 0.80 V when photons of energy 2.8 eV fall on the cathode. Find (i) the maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons in joule (ii) their maximum speed (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) (iii) the work function of the cathode in eV. (3 marks)
(Aik photoelectric tajurbe mein 2.8 eV ke photons cathode par parte hain aur stopping potential 0.80 V hai. (i) Photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy joule mein (ii) un ki zyada se zyada raftaar (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) (iii) cathode ka work function eV mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Stopping potential se (K.E.)max = V₀e; ½mv²max se vmax; photon ki energy − (K.E.)max = φ.

book_ref.quote: where m is mass, v is velocity and e is the charge on electron.

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain the photoelectric effect on the basis of quantum theory. Derive Einstein's photoelectric equation and write it in terms of the threshold frequency. Why does the equation hold only for some of the emitted electrons? (5 marks)
(Quantum theory ki bunyaad par photoelectric effect ki wazahat karein. Einstein ki photoelectric equation nikalein aur use threshold frequency ki shakal mein likhein. Yeh equation sirf kuch electrons par kyun lagu hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Quantum wazahat: Einstein ne Planck ka khayal barhaya: roshni photons ki shakal mein kharij ya jazb hoti hai, har photon ki energy E = hf. Aik photon dhaat ki satah ka aik hi electron jazb karta hai. Electron ko nikalne ke liye kam se kam energy, work function φ, chahiye. Agar photon ki energy kaafi ho to electron foran nikal aata hai: energy ka aik hissa dhaat se alag hone mein lagta hai aur baaqi kinetic energy ban jati hai.

Derivation:
Photon ki energy − Work function = photoelectron ki (K.E.)max
hf − φ = ½mv²max ... (18.5)
Yeh Einstein ki photoelectric equation hai.

Threshold frequency: Jab (K.E.)max = 0 ho to f = f₀, is liye
hf₀ − φ = 0, ya φ = hf₀ ... (18.6)
Eq. 18.5 mein rakhne se:
(K.E.)max = hf − hf₀ ... (18.7)
Yani f < f₀ par koi electron nahi nikalta, aur (K.E.)max frequency se barhti hai, intensity se nahi; zyada intensity = zyada photons = zyada electrons.

Sirf kuch electrons kyun: Tamaam electrons ki K.E. zyada se zyada nahi hoti; kuch seedhe nikalte hain aur kuch atomi takkaron mein energy kho dete hain. Eq. 18.7 sirf poori zaid energy wale electrons par lagu hai.

Agar roshni yaksaan phaili energy wali wave ho to yeh effect wazeh nahi hota; yeh roshni ki zarrati fitrat dikhata hai. Einstein ko is wazahat par 1921 ka Nobel Prize mila.

book_ref.quote: A photon could be absorbed by a single electron in the metal surface.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein Eq. 18.6 'f' ke saath chhapi hai; threshold par frequency f₀ hai, is liye sahi shakal φ = hf₀ hai (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
6 The work function of a metal is 2.2 eV. Light of wavelength 420 nm falls on it. Find (i) the threshold frequency (ii) the maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons in eV (iii) the stopping potential. (3 marks)
(Aik dhaat ka work function 2.2 eV hai. Us par 420 nm wavelength ki roshni parti hai. (i) Threshold frequency (ii) photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy eV mein (iii) stopping potential nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: φ = hf₀ se f₀, hc/λ se photon ki energy, phir (K.E.)max = hf − φ aur V₀ = (K.E.)max/e.

book_ref.quote: Hence, we can also write Einstein's photoelectric equation as

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the Compton effect? Using conservation of energy and momentum, write the equations for the collision of an X-ray photon with an electron at rest, state the expression for the Compton shift, and explain the Compton wavelength. (5 marks)
(Compton effect kya hai? Energy aur momentum ki conservation se X-ray photon aur rukay hue electron ke takraao ki equations likhein, Compton shift ka formula bayan karein aur Compton wavelength ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Compton effect: Compton (1923) ne graphite target ke dheele bandhe electrons se X-rays bikhrain (Fig. 18.5) aur dekha ke bikhri X-rays ki wavelength girne wali X-rays se zyada hai. Classical wave theory isay wazeh na kar saki. Compton ne X-rays ko energy hc/λ aur momentum h/λ wale photons maana.

Takraao (Fig. 18.6): hf = hc/λ energy ka X-ray photon rukay hue electron se billiard gend ki tarah takrata hai. Photon θ angle par kam energy hf′ = hc/λ′ ke saath bikharta hai, aur electron φ angle par K.E. = (m − m₀)c² ke saath peeche hatta hai (m chalte electron ka mass, m₀ rest mass). Yeh elastic takraao hai: energy aur momentum dono conserved.

Energy ki conservation:
Photon ki energy mein tabdeeli = electron ki K.E.
hf − hf′ = mc² − m₀c²
hc/λ − hc/λ′ = (m − m₀)c²

Momentum ki conservation (vector hai, is liye x aur y mein):
x-component: h/λ + 0 = (h/λ′) cos θ + mv cos φ
y-component: 0 + 0 = (h/λ′) sin θ − mv sin φ

Nateeja: In equations ko hal karne se
λ′ = λ + (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ)
Δλ = λ′ − λ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ) ... (18.8)

Compton wavelength: h/m₀c ki dimensions wavelength wali hain:
h/m₀c = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/(9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 3 × 10⁸) = 2.43 × 10⁻¹² m
θ = 90° par Δλ Compton wavelength ke barabar hai. Eq. 18.8 tajurbe se poori tarah mutabiq thi, jo electromagnetic waves ke maadde se zarrati andaaz ke amal ki pukhta tasdeeq hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider scattering of a photon by an electron in which the photon suffers collision with the electron like a billiard ball.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ki x-momentum equation mein (h/λ) cos θ chhapa hai; bikharne ke baad wavelength λ′ hai, is liye (h/λ′) cos θ likhein. Aur shift ki equation ka number 18.8 hai, 18.6 nahi (book corrections).

blocks.prompt:
8 X-rays of wavelength 20.0 pm are scattered through 120° by loosely bound electrons. Find (i) the Compton shift (ii) the wavelength of the scattered X-rays (iii) the energies of the incident and scattered photons in keV. (h/m₀c = 2.43 pm) (3 marks)
(20.0 pm wavelength ki X-rays dheele bandhe electrons se 120° par bikharti hain. (i) Compton shift (ii) bikhri X-rays ki wavelength (iii) girne wale aur bikhre photons ki energies keV mein nikalein. (h/m₀c = 2.43 pm))
blocks.explanation: θ = 120° ko Δλ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ) mein rakhein, λ mein jama karein, phir har photon ke liye E = hc/λ.

book_ref.quote: If the scattered X-ray photons are observed at θ = 90°, the Compton shift Δλ equals the Compton wavelength.

steps: E′ = hc/λ′ = 8.41 × 10⁻¹⁵ J = 52.6 keV (farq 9.6 keV electron le jata hai)
blocks.final_answer: (i) Δλ = 3.65 pm (ii) λ′ ≈ 23.6 pm (iii) E = 62.2 keV, E′ = 52.6 keV

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the interaction of electromagnetic radiation with matter at low, intermediate and high photon energies. Explain pair production with its energy equation, find the minimum photon energy needed for it, and explain annihilation of matter. (5 marks)
(Kam, darmiyani aur zyada photon energies par electromagnetic radiation ka maadde se amal bayan karein. Pair production ko us ki energy equation ke saath wazeh karein, is ke liye kam se kam photon energy nikalein aur annihilation of matter ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Maadde se amal:
(i) Kam energies (0.5 MeV se kam) par ghalib amal photoelectric effect hai: photon electron jazb karta hai jo nikal jata hai.
(ii) Darmiyani energies par Compton effect: photon electron se lambi wavelength ke saath bikharta hai.
(iii) Zyada energies (1.2 MeV se zyada) par pair production.

Pair production: Bohat zyada energy wala photon (maslan γ-ray) maadde se mil kar electron-positron jore mein badal jata hai, Einstein ki energy equation ke mutabiq:
Photon ki energy = jora banane ki energy + zarraat ki K.E.
hf = 2m₀c² + K.E.(e⁻) + K.E.(e⁺) ... (18.9)
jahan m₀c² electron (aur positron) ki rest mass energy hai.

Kam se kam energy: Jab dono zarraat ki K.E. zero ho:
hf(min) = 2m₀c² = 2 × 0.51 MeV = 1.02 MeV
(0.51 MeV electron ki rest mass energy hai, jaisa Example 18.3 mein.) Zyada energy wala photon baaqi energy jore ko K.E. ki shakal mein deta hai.

Annihilation of matter: Pair production ka ulat. Particle aur us ka antiparticle mil kar γ-ray range ke zyada energy wale photons ban jate hain:
e⁻ + e⁺ = γ + γ
Rukay hue electron-positron jore se do photons bante hain, har aik 0.51 MeV ka, jin ki wavelength λ = hc/E = 2.43 pm (Example 18.3).

book_ref.quote: It is pair production in which photon energy is changed into electron-positron pair

blocks.prompt:
10 A γ-ray photon of energy 2.50 MeV produces an electron-positron pair. The rest mass energy of an electron is 0.51 MeV. Find (i) the total kinetic energy of the pair (ii) the kinetic energy of each if shared equally (iii) the minimum frequency of a photon that can produce a pair. (3 marks)
(2.50 MeV energy ka γ-ray photon electron-positron jora banata hai. Electron ki rest mass energy 0.51 MeV hai. (i) Jore ki kul kinetic energy (ii) barabar taqseem ho to har aik ki kinetic energy (iii) jora bana sakne wale photon ki kam se kam frequency nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: hf = 2m₀c² + K.E.(e⁻) + K.E.(e⁺) lagayein; kam se kam energy 2m₀c² hai, phir f = E/h.

book_ref.quote: the converse of pair-production is known as annihilation of matter

blocks.final_answer: (i) 1.48 MeV (ii) har aik 0.74 MeV (iii) f(min) = 2.46 × 10²⁰ Hz

blocks.prompt:
11 State de Broglie's hypothesis and derive the de Broglie relation. Using the examples of a rifle bullet and an electron, explain why wave effects are observed for electrons but not for objects of everyday life. (5 marks)
(de Broglie ka mafrooza bayan karein aur de Broglie relation nikalein. Rifle ki goli aur electron ki misaalon se wazahat karein ke wave asraat electrons mein nazar aate hain magar rozmarra ki cheezon mein kyun nahi.)
blocks.explanation:
Mafrooza: Roshni dohri fitrat dikhati hai: wave bhi aur zarra bhi. Fitrat ki symmetry maan kar Louis de Broglie ne 1924 mein kaha ke maadde ke zarraat mein bhi wave jaisi khasusiyaat honi chahiye.

Derivation: Photon ka momentum
p = h/λ (Eq. 18.3)
de Broglie ke mutabiq m mass aur v velocity wale zarre ka momentum bhi isi formula se milta hai:
p = h/λ = mv
λ = h/p = h/mv ... (18.10)
jahan λ zarre ki wave ki wavelength hai. Yeh de Broglie relation hai; is liye electron ko zarra aur wave dono samjha ja sakta hai.

Rifle ki goli (m = 20 g, v = 330 m s⁻¹):
λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/(2 × 10⁻² × 330) = 1 × 10⁻³⁴ m
Yeh itni chhoti hai ke kisi asar se napi ya pakdi nahi ja sakti. Bare mass aur aam raftaar wali cheez ke interference aur diffraction asraat na-qabil-e-zikr hain.

Electron (v = 1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹):
λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/(9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 1 × 10⁶) = 7 × 10⁻¹⁰ m
Yeh X-ray range mein hai, is liye electrons ke diffraction asraat qabil-e-pemaish hain jab ke goliyon ke nahi.

de Broglie ko 1929 mein Nobel Prize mila.

book_ref.quote: It has been observed that light displays a dual nature, it acts as a wave and it acts as a particle.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein Eq. 18.10 'λ = h/ρ' chhapi hai; ρ ghalti se likha gaya, yeh momentum p hai: λ = h/p = h/mv. Book is relation ko 'Equation 18.9' bhi kehti hai; sahi number 18.10 hai (book corrections).

blocks.prompt:
12 Find the de Broglie wavelength of (i) a proton (m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) moving at 2.0 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹ (ii) a cricket ball of mass 0.05 kg moving at 20 m s⁻¹. Which one can show diffraction? (3 marks)
(In ki de Broglie wavelength nikalein: (i) 2.0 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹ se chalta proton (m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) (ii) 20 m s⁻¹ se chalti 0.05 kg ki cricket gend. Kaun diffraction dikha sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har aik par λ = h/mv lagayein, phir wavelengths ka atomi size se muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: where λ is the wavelength associated with particle waves.

steps: Proton ki wavelength chhoti magar qabil-e-pemaish hai (protons ka diffraction dekha gaya hai); gend ki bohat hi chhoti hai.
blocks.final_answer: (i) λ(proton) = 1.99 × 10⁻¹² m (ii) λ(gend) = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ m; sirf proton diffraction dikha sakta hai

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the Davisson and Germer experiment. Derive the de Broglie wavelength of an electron accelerated through a potential difference V, and show how the experiment confirmed the de Broglie wavelength. (5 marks)
(Davisson aur Germer ka tajurba bayan karein. V potential difference se tez kiye gaye electron ki de Broglie wavelength nikalein, aur dikhayein ke tajurbe ne de Broglie wavelength ki tasdeeq kaise ki.)
blocks.explanation:
Tajurba (Fig. 18.7): Garam filament se nikle electrons electron gun mein adjustable voltage V se tez kiye jate hain. Ve energy ki beam nickel crystal par daali jati hai. Crystal se diffract hui beam detector mein ja kar current I ki shakal mein record hoti hai. Bikhre electrons baqaida peaks mein aaye, jinhein NaCl crystal se X-ray diffraction ki tarah diffraction samjha gaya. Yani electrons dhaat ke crystals se bilkul X-rays ki tarah diffract hote hain.

Derivation: V se tez hone par electron ki K.E. mein izafa
½mv² = Ve
mv² = 2Ve, ya m²v² = 2mVe
mv = √(2mVe)
de Broglie equation λ = h/mv se:
λ = h/√(2mVe) ... (18.11)

Tasdeeq: Aik tajurbe mein V = 54 V:
λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/√(2 × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 54 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 1.67 × 10⁻¹⁰ m (book 1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m deti hai)
Diffracted beam 65° glancing angle par mili. Bragg ki equation 2d sin θ = mλ se, m = 1 aur nickel ke liye d = 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ m:
λ = 2 × 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ × sin 65° = 1.65 × 10⁻¹⁰ m
Tajurbati wavelength peshgoi se bilkul mutabiq hai.

Protons, neutrons, hydrogen aur helium atoms ke saath bhi diffraction dekha gaya hai, jo zarraat ki wave fitrat ka mazboot saboot hai. Davisson aur G. P. Thomson ne 1937 ka Nobel Prize baanta.

book_ref.quote: A convincing evidence of the wave nature of electrons was provided by Clinton J. Davisson

blocks.prompt:
14 Electrons are accelerated from rest through 150 V and diffracted by a nickel crystal (d = 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ m). Find (i) the momentum of the electrons (ii) their de Broglie wavelength (iii) the glancing angle for first order diffraction. (3 marks)
(Electrons sakoon se 150 V par tez kar ke nickel crystal (d = 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ m) se diffract kiye jate hain. (i) Electrons ka momentum (ii) un ki de Broglie wavelength (iii) pehle order ke diffraction ka glancing angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: mv = √(2mVe) nikalein, phir λ = h/mv, phir m = 1 ke liye Bragg ki equation 2d sin θ = λ.

book_ref.quote: This beam of electrons diffracted from crystal surface was obtained for a glancing angle of 65°.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is wave-particle duality? Using experiments on light and on electrons, explain Bohr's principle of complementarity and how the nature of an experiment decides which aspect is revealed. (5 marks)
(Wave-particle duality kya hai? Roshni aur electrons ke tajurbaat ki madad se Bohr ka principle of complementarity wazeh karein aur batayein ke tajurbe ki noiyat kaise tay karti hai ke kaun sa pehlu zahir ho.)
blocks.explanation:
Roshni ke saboot: Interference aur diffraction roshni ki wave fitrat dikhate hain; photoelectric effect aur Compton effect zarrati fitrat sabit karte hain.
Electrons ke saboot: Davisson-Germer aur G. P. Thomson ke tajurbaat electrons ki wave fitrat dikhate hain, jab ke J. J. Thomson ke e/m tajurbe mein electron ko zarra maanna para. Double slit se guzarti electron beam roshni ki tarah raushan aur tareek fringes banati hai, sirf slits ki do tasveerein nahi.

Wave-particle duality: Tamaam maadde (electrons, protons, neutrons, molecules) aur radiation (roshni, X-rays, γ-rays) ke liye wave aur particle dono khasusiyaat maanni parti hain. Maadde aur radiation ki dohri 'wave-particle' fitrat hi wave-particle duality hai. Khurd zarraat waves ki tarah safar karte aur zarraat ki tarah energy ka len den karte hain.

Principle of complementarity (Niels Bohr): Radiation aur maadde ki mukammal tasveer ke liye wave aur particle dono pehlu zaroori hain. Dono hamesha maujood hain aur koi bhi tajurbe mein zahir ho sakta hai, magar aik hi tajurbe mein dono aik saath zahir nahi hote.

Tajurbe ka kirdar: Dono pehlu roshni ke alag 'chehre' hain; tajurbe ki noiyat tay karti hai kaun sa dikhe. Roshni ke raaste mein diffraction grating use wave zahir karti hai; dhaat par girti roshni ko zarraat ki dhaar maanna parta hai. Koi saada tajurba aisa nahi jo beam ko aik waqt mein wave aur zarra dono maanne par majboor kare. Roshni maadde se milte waqt photons ki dhaar aur source se detector tak safar mein wave ki tarah bartao karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Niels Bohr pointed out in stating his principle of complementarity

blocks.prompt:
16 A photon and an electron (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) each have a wavelength of 0.20 nm. Find (i) the energy of the photon in eV (ii) the speed of the electron (iii) the kinetic energy of the electron in eV. (3 marks)
(Aik photon aur aik electron (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) dono ki wavelength 0.20 nm hai. (i) Photon ki energy eV mein (ii) electron ki raftaar (iii) electron ki kinetic energy eV mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Photon ke liye E = hc/λ; electron ke liye wahi wavelength momentum h/λ = mv deti hai, phir v aur ½mv².

book_ref.quote: In effect, all micro-particles (electrons, protons, photons, atoms, etc.)

steps: Electron: mv = h/λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/(0.20 × 10⁻⁹) = 3.32 × 10⁻²⁴ kg m s⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: (i) 6.2 × 10³ eV (6.2 keV) (ii) 3.64 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ (iii) 37.7 eV: wavelength aik, energies bohat mukhtalif

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan wavelength barabar hai magar photon ki energy hc/λ aur electron ki energy p²/2m alag formulas se milti hai, is liye nataij bohat mukhtalif hain.

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain the principle and working of the transmission electron microscope with a labelled description of its lenses. Why is its resolution much higher than that of an optical microscope? Give its uses. (5 marks)
(Transmission electron microscope ka usool aur kaam us ke lenses ki tafseel ke saath bayan karein. Is ki resolution optical microscope se bohat zyada kyun hai? Is ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: Electron microscope electrons ki wave fitrat istemal karta hai. Un ki de Broglie wavelength nazar aane wali roshni se taqreeban hazaar guna chhoti hai, is liye yeh woh bareek tafseel dikhata hai jo optical microscope nahi dikha sakta.

Kaam (Fig. 18.8):
(i) Source se nikle electrons kai megavolts voltage se tez kiye jate hain.
(ii) Woh electromagnetic condenser lens se guzarte hain jo beam ko specimen par focus karta hai.
(iii) Electromagnetic objective lens specimen ki image banata hai.
(iv) Electromagnetic projector lens image ko mazeed bara kar ke film par tasveer banata hai, jise micrograph kehte hain.

Resolution: λ = h/mv. Electrons ki raftaar jitni zyada, wavelength utni chhoti aur resolution utni zyada. Is liye electron microscope nano-metric yani taqreeban atomi satah tak tafseel dekh sakta hai. Jadeed scanning electron microscopes behtareen teen-dimensional images dete hain.

Istemal: microbiology mein cell ki banawat, viruses aur bacteria ka mutala; dhaat ki daraaron ki tafteesh; materials aur crystal structure ka mutala.

book_ref.quote: The electrons from a source are passed through the electromagnetic lens called condenser

blocks.prompt:
18 In an electron microscope, electrons are accelerated from rest through 5.0 kV. Find (i) their momentum (ii) their de Broglie wavelength (iii) how many times shorter it is than light of wavelength 550 nm. (Treat the electrons non-relativistically.) (3 marks)
(Aik electron microscope mein electrons sakoon se 5.0 kV par tez kiye jate hain. (i) Un ka momentum (ii) de Broglie wavelength (iii) yeh 550 nm ki roshni se kitne guna chhoti hai, nikalein. (Electrons ko non-relativistic maanein.))
blocks.explanation: mv = √(2mVe) aur λ = h/mv lagayein, phir 550 nm ko λ se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: The higher is the speed of electrons, the shorter is the wavelength and hence, higher is the resolution.

blocks.final_answer: (i) 3.82 × 10⁻²³ kg m s⁻¹ (ii) λ = 1.74 × 10⁻¹¹ m (iii) taqreeban 3.2 × 10⁴ guna chhoti

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the experimental arrangement for observing atomic spectra. Write the formulas for the Balmer, Lyman and Paschen series of hydrogen with their regions and the values of n, and explain how the emission spectrum arises from ground and excited states. (5 marks)
(Atomic spectra dekhne ka tajurbati intizam bayan karein. Hydrogen ki Balmer, Lyman aur Paschen series ke formulas un ke hisson aur n ki qeematon ke saath likhein, aur wazahat karein ke ground aur excited states se emission spectrum kaise banta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Intizam (Fig. 18.9): Discharge tube, spectrometer aur diffraction grating. Eyepiece se tareek pas-e-manzar par lines ka silsila nazar aata hai. Mukhtalif elements ke bukharaat ki lines ke pattern alag hain (spectral series) jin se elements pehchane jate hain.

Balmer series (visible): J. J. Balmer (1885) ne hydrogen ke spectrum mein pehchani; visible hissay mein chaar lines. Rydberg ka formula:
1/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²), n = 3, 4, 5, ...
jahan R_H = 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹ Rydberg constant hai.

Lyman series (ultraviolet):
1/λ = R_H(1/1² − 1/n²), n = 2, 3, 4, ... (18.12)

Paschen series (infrared):
1/λ = R_H(1/3² − 1/n²), n = 4, 5, 6, ... (18.13)

Energy levels aur emission (Figs. 18.11, 18.12): Yeh equations alag hydrogen atom mein electron ki ijazat-shuda energies deti hain. n = 1 ground state hai; n = 2, 3, 4, ... excited states. Atom sirf khaas miqdaar mein energy jazb kar ke excited state mein jata hai. Excited states ki umar bohat kam hai; electron jald photons kharij karte hue neeche aata hai, jo kai lines wala emission spectrum banate hain. n = 1 par khatam hone wali transitions Lyman, n = 2 par Balmer aur n = 3 par Paschen series deti hain.

book_ref.quote: The evidence of particle nature of quantized photons using spectrometer is the basis of atomic spectra.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ke Balmer aur Lyman formulas mein baayen taraf h/λ chhapa hai, aur Lyman formula mein 1/2² likha hai. Sahi: baayen taraf 1/λ, aur Lyman mein 1/1² (n = 1 par khatam) (book corrections).

blocks.prompt:
20 Find (i) the wavelength of the second line of the Balmer series (n = 4 to n = 2) (ii) the energy of its photon in eV. (R_H = 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Yeh nikalein: (i) Balmer series ki doosri line (n = 4 se n = 2) ki wavelength (ii) us ke photon ki energy eV mein. (R_H = 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Balmer formula mein n = 4 rakh kar 1/λ nikalein, ulta karein, phir E = hc/λ.

book_ref.quote: where n is the discrete excited energy level of the electrons with values 3,4,5,... and R_H is the Rydberg constant.

blocks.prompt:
21 Explain how an atom is excited by absorbing energy and how it returns. Using this, explain why the dark lines in the absorption spectrum of an element appear at the same wavelengths as the bright lines of its emission spectrum. State the condition for excitation by a photon and by an electron, and name the types of spectra. (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke atom energy jazb kar ke kaise excite hota hai aur kaise wapas aata hai. Is ki madad se batayein ke kisi element ke absorption spectrum ki tareek lines usi ke emission spectrum ki raushan lines wali wavelengths par kyun hoti hain. Photon aur electron se excitation ki shart bayan karein aur spectra ki qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Excitation aur wapsi: Atom sirf khaas miqdaar mein energy jazb karta hai aur us ka electron oopar ke level (excited state) par chala jata hai. Excited states ki umar bohat kam hai; electron photon kharij kar ke neeche aata hai. Photon ki energy dono levels ke farq ke barabar hai:
hf = Eₙ − Eₚ

Absorption spectrum: Jab continuous spectrum wali roshni (maslan safaid roshni) kam pressure wali gas se guzarti hai to kuch wavelengths ghaib ho jati hain aur un ki jagah tareek lines aati hain. Guzarte waqt electrons oopar ki transitions ke liye khaas miqdaar mein energy jazb karte hain; sirf woh photons jazb hote hain jin ki energy bilkul darkaar energy ke barabar ho.

Emission spectrum: Jab yeh excited electrons neeche aate hain to unhi khaas wavelengths ke photons kharij hote hain, jo emission line spectrum banate hain.

Rishta (Fig. 18.13): Dono mein levels ke wahi jore shamil hain, is liye absorption spectrum se ghaib wavelengths bilkul wahi hain jo usi element ke emission spectrum mein maujood hain.

Excitation ki shart: Photon ki energy dono levels ke farq ke bilkul barabar honi chahiye, magar electron ki K.E. farq ke barabar ya zyada ho to bhi gas atoms excite ho jate hain.

Spectra ki qismein: continuous spectrum, line spectrum aur band spectrum.

book_ref.quote: As the light passes through the gas, electrons absorb discrete amount of energy and make transition to higher energy levels.

blocks.prompt:
22 A hydrogen atom in the ground state absorbs a photon and is raised to the level n = 3. Using 1/λ = R_H(1/1² − 1/n²), find (i) the wavelength of the photon absorbed (ii) the energy difference between the two levels in eV (iii) the least kinetic energy of an electron that could cause the same excitation. (R_H = 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Ground state wala hydrogen atom aik photon jazb kar ke n = 3 level par jata hai. 1/λ = R_H(1/1² − 1/n²) se (i) jazb hone wale photon ki wavelength (ii) dono levels ka energy farq eV mein (iii) yahi excitation karne wale electron ki kam se kam kinetic energy nikalein. (R_H = 1.0974 × 10⁷ m⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Jazb hone wali wavelength n = 3 wali Lyman line hai; us ke photon ki energy hc/λ levels ka farq hai; electron ko kam az kam itni K.E. chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The wavelengths of light absorbed correspond exactly to energy needed to make such upward transitions.

steps: Electron ki K.E. farq ke barabar ya zyada ho: K.E.(min) = 12.1 eV

blocks.prompt:
23 State Heisenberg's uncertainty principle and derive Δx.Δp ≈ h using a photon of wavelength λ. Use it to show that electrons cannot exist inside the nucleus, and write the energy-time form and Heisenberg's more careful forms of the principle. (5 marks)
(Heisenberg ka uncertainty principle bayan karein aur λ wavelength ke photon se Δx.Δp ≈ h nikalein. Is se sabit karein ke electrons nucleus ke andar nahi ho sakte, aur energy-time shakal aur Heisenberg ki zyada mohtaat shaklein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Zarre ki position aur momentum aik saath bilkul durust nahi nape ja sakte. Yeh bunyaadi uncertainty aale ki wajah se nahi balke maadde aur radiation ki wave-particle duality ka nateeja hai (Heisenberg, 1927). Bare ajsaam ke liye na-qabil-e-zikr hai (photons urti tennis gend par asar nahi karte) magar atomi dunya mein ghalib (aik photon electron ki harkat bilkul badal deta hai).

Derivation: Roshni wave fitrat rakhti hai, is liye electron ki position sirf aik wavelength ke andar maloom hoti hai. λ wavelength ki roshni se x-axis par chalte zarre ki jagah dekhein:
Δx ≈ λ
Photon zyada se zyada apna poora momentum h/λ de sakta hai, is liye
Δp ≈ h/λ
Zarb dene se:
Δx.Δp ≈ λ(h/λ) ≈ h ... (18.14)
Aik lamhe par position ki uncertainty Δx aur momentum ke x-component ki uncertainty Δp ka hasil-e-zarb taqreeban h hai. Chhoti wavelength Δx kam karti hai magar harkat badal kar Δp barha deti hai.

Electrons nucleus mein nahi: Nucleus 10⁻¹⁵ m ke darje ka hai, is liye Δx ≈ 10⁻¹⁵ m:
Δp ≈ h/Δx ≈ 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴/1 × 10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹ kg m s⁻¹
Is se energy ki uncertainty GeV ke darje ki banti hai. Atom mein aisa electron nahi milta, is liye electrons nucleus ke andar nahi hote.

Energy-time shakal:
ΔE.Δt ≈ h ... (18.15)
Energy jitni durust maloom ho, us energy ke waqt ki uncertainty utni zyada.

Heisenberg ki mohtaat shaklein: Behtareen soorat mein
Δx.Δp ≥ ħ aur ΔE.Δt ≥ ħ, jahan ħ = h/2π = 1.05 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.

book_ref.quote: If light of wavelength λ is used to locate a micro-particle moving along x-axis, the uncertainty in its position measurement is:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein Δp ki unit J s chhapi hai; momentum ki unit kg m s⁻¹ hai. Equation ka number (8.14) bhi asal mein 18.14 hai (book corrections).

blocks.prompt:
24 Answer both parts: (i) An electron (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) is confined to a region 5.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ m wide. Find the uncertainty in its momentum and velocity. (ii) An excited atom radiates for about 2 × 10⁻⁹ s. Find the uncertainty in the energy of the emitted photon in eV. (3 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein: (i) Aik electron (m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) 5.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ m chaure ilaqe mein band hai. Us ke momentum aur velocity ki uncertainty nikalein. (ii) Aik excited atom taqreeban 2 × 10⁻⁹ s radiation deta hai. Kharij photon ki energy ki uncertainty eV mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) ke liye Δp ≈ h/Δx aur Δv = Δp/m, (ii) ke liye ΔE ≈ h/Δt.

book_ref.quote: Using the formula Δp.Δx ≈ h As Δp ≈ mΔv Hence mΔv.Δx = h, Δv = h/(m × Δx)

blocks.final_answer: (i) Δp = 1.33 × 10⁻²⁴ kg m s⁻¹, Δv = 1.46 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ (ii) ΔE = 2.1 × 10⁻⁶ eV
